instagram.label: Instagram Reels
instagram.notes: The current diagram adds a lower-right inset to the usual margins. Meta also describes cropping on taller devices. Reels ads with disclaimers reserve the full bottom 40%; use that variant when applicable.
instagram.derivation: Diagram: top 14%, bottom 35%, sides 6%; lower-right notch covers the rightmost 21% over the bottom 40%.

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.notes: This is the standard LTR reference, without an anchor. TikTok supplies separate anchor and Arabic-region RTL files. Longer descriptions and other formats can change the usable area; the live result can differ from the preview.
tiktok.derivation: Template labels use 720 × 1280: top 160, bottom 440, sides 80, extra right inset 120 over the bottom 720. Scale coordinates by 1.5 for 1080 × 1920. Downloaded image is 2880 × 5120.

usage: Compose the full portrait frame from project design first. For organic video, use local UI reservations and actual app previews; do not enforce this ad-template intersection as a blanket layout boundary.
